title: QUIET TIME, BIBLICAL FASTING AND PRAYERS

blocks.text: Quiet time is the time set aside to meet with God. It is the time set aside to communicate with the Father through the living Word with the assistance of the Holy Spirit. It is also a time to bring, our request to God in prayer. Through Quiet Time we cultivate a relationship with God. In this study, we shall also discuss how to have effective quiet time on a daily basis with God. {{mt 6:34|Math 6:34}} Says sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.

cards.heading: 1. Why the need for quiet time

items: We need Gods power to cope with the daily activities. {{1kgs 19:7|I Kings 19:7}}; {{jo 15:5|John 15:5}}; Is 40:31
We pattern our lives after our Lord Jesus Christ's life by following His steps. {{mt 14:23|Mt. 14:23}}; {{mk 1:35|Mk 1:35}}; 6:46; I Pet. 2:21
To cultivate personal habit of worshipping; the Lord helps our personal devotion. I Pet. 2:2; {{js 1:8|Josh. 1:8}}; {{ps 1:1,ps 1:2,ps 1:3|Ps. 1: 1-3}}; {{ps 95:6|Ps. 95:6}}

To create personal adjustment to the teachings of the Bible; i.e. living by the Word, reacting positively or negatively to the Bible. Jn. 1:21-25; {{mt 4:4|Mt. 4:4}}; I Pet. 2:2; {{jm 1:21,jm 1:22,jm 1:23,jm 1:24,jm 1:25|James 1:21-25}}

For God"s power to live an overcoming life, helps Create right reaction to trials and temptations: Substance already imparted in us helps create right reactions to situations and circumstances. I Pet. 1:3-7; {{hb 12:10,hb 12:11|Heb. 12:10-11}}; {{jm 1:24|James 1:24}}.

cards.heading: 2. Time and place of quiet time

items: Frequency: At least once a day. {{dn 6:10|Dan. 6:10}}.
Period of the day should be an acceptable time, preferably early in the morning. {{mk 1:3|Mk. 1:3}} 5; {{prv 8:17|Prov. 8:17}}; {{ps 5:3|Ps. 5:3}}; {{gn 19:27|Gen. 19:27}}
Waking thoughts are focused on God.
Strength is received to meet the challenges of the day. {{eph 6:10,eph 6:11,eph 6:12|Eph 6:10-12}}
Place: The place chosen for quiet time should be secluded from noise and distractions.
What you require
The Holy Bible (it is advisable to have more than one version and a good reference of the
Bible at your side).
Hymn book/chorus book and dictionary
Notebook and pen
List of prayer points
Aid, Daily Power, Everyday with Jesus etc.
Begin with some praise and worship songs. {{eph 5:19|Eph. 5:19}}, a short prayer. {{ps 119:18|Ps. 119: 18}}; {{jo 16:13,jo 16:14,jo 16:15|John 16: 13-15}},
Read slowly and meditatively through a predetermined portion of the Bible ({{ps 119:18,ps 119:105|Ps. 119:18, 105}})
Providing answers to the following questions where applicable:
What is the main subject of the passage or book?
Who are the persons revealed in the passage?
Who is speaking? About whom is he speaking?
What is the key verse(s) of the passage?
Is there any sin for me to confess and forsake? {{prv 28:13|Prov. 28:13}}
Is there any commandment for me to obey?
Is there any promise for me to claim?

cards.heading: 6. Methods of Bible study during quiet time

items: By chapters,
By paragraphs,
By verses,
By books,
By topics,
Through biography,
Benefits of quiet time
It provides an opportunity for the soul to linger in the presence of God.
It creates an atmosphere of God"s presence
It brings about the working knowledge of the Bible.
It produces the desire to know God and to do His will.

cards.heading: 8. How Does God speak to us?

items: By Vision Acts 1 0:3; {{jl 2:28|Joel 2:28}}; Is. 6:1-4.
The Still Small Voice {{1kgs 19:12|I Kings 19:12}}.
Inward Witness {{prv 20:27|Prov. 20:27}}; I Cor. 2: 11.
Audible Voice {{act 10:13|Acts 10: 13}}; I Sam. 3:4.
Through the gifts of the Holy Spirit, e.g. prophecy, word of wisdom, word of knowledge, etc. I Cor. 14:3-4; II Pet. 1:19-21; Deut.18:20-21.

blocks.text: Discuss possible obstacles to a fruitful quiet time: Haste, disturbance, bad planning, Laziness, over-eating, monotony due to using one method of study, Telephone etc. {{ne 13:1,ne 13:2,ne 13:3,ne 13:4,ne 13:5|Neh. 13: 1-5}}, the enemy is revealed, you know people and what to avoid, generational curses, your oppressor are displaced, and the old king is displaced.

Prayer Prayer can be defined as divine communication with God. It is a dialogue and waiting to hear from God. 1 Sam1:15, {{is 26:16|Isa. 26:16}}. It is also the pouring out of the heart before God {{ps 62:8|Psalm 62:8}}

items: Types of Prayers:
Adoration: i.e. praise and worship of God for who he is (God is good, merciful, kind, powerful, faithful, just, righteous etc. {{ps 96:6|Psalm 96:6}},
Confession: repentance from every known sin. {{ps 32:5|Psalm 32:5}}
Thanksgiving Mathew 6: 9-13: i.e. be thankful for anything and everything that God has done, is doing and will do for you. {{ph 4:6|Phil. 4:6}}:
Supplication: i.e. intercession, requests, petitions and all our desires can now be addressed to God, in the name of Jesus through the power of the Holy Spirit. {{1tm 2:1|1 Tim. 2:1}}
Where can I pray? We can pray anywhere, in the closet, in the church, in the secret, in the open, alone and or with other people or family members. {{1tm 2:8|1 Tim. 2:8}}, MT.6:6, Lk.18:10

blocks.text: 3. When can I pray? We can pray in the Morning, at noon, in the evening, during the day and or night, daily and or always. It is not only when you are on your knees with your eyes closed that you can pray. You can pray as you drive to work, while at work, while resting; singing praises to God is a form of prayer. Pray without ceasing

items: For what am I to pray? Many people cannot pray long because their prayer is selfish, that is they pray only for themselves
Pray for the sick {{jm 5:13,jm 5:14,jm 5:15,jm 5:16|James 5:13-16}}
Pray for your country, and the government
Pray for all men: the president, governors, legislators, pastors, church, workers, the pregnant in the church, ministries etc 1 Tim.2:1-4
Pray for every Christian to be made perfect. {{cl 1:28|Col. 1:28}}
Pray for your enemies. Mt.5:38-48
Pray for wisdom and understanding. {{1kgs 3:5,1kgs 3:6,1kgs 3:7,1kgs 3:8,1kgs 3:9|1 kings 3:5-9}}
Pray for personal safety and that of others, the will of God, forgiveness, guidance, victory over temptation, {{mt 6:9,mt 6:10,mt 6:11,mt 6:12,mt 6:13|Matt. 6:9-13}}
Pray for long, healthy life. {{is 38:1,is 38:2,is 38:3,is 38:4,is 38:5|Isa. 38:1-5}}
Pray for the second coming of Christ. {{mt 6:9,mt 6:10,mt 6:11,mt 6:12,mt 6:13|Matt. 6:9-13}} You can see that it is not difficult to pray without ceasing
How can I pray effectively?
Pray with boldness. Heb.4:16; {{is 41:21|Isa. 41:21}}; 43:26,
Pray with a renew Mind. Jer.3:15; {{1sm 2:35|1Sam. 2:35}};
Pray persistently {{lk 18:1,lk 18:2,lk 18:3,lk 18:4,lk 18:5,lk 18:6,lk 18:7,lk 18:8|Lk. 18:1-8}}
Do not pray or ask God for something that is contrary to his will or that contradict the Bible {{mt 26:39|Matt. 26:39}}
Forgive others if you want God to answer your prayers {{mk 11:25|Mk. 11:25}}
Be guided by the Holy spirit in praying: rom.8:26-27
Pray in Jesus name {{jo 16:24|John 16:24}}
After you have prayed wait on the Lord {{is 40:31|Isa. 40:31}}; {{prv 20:22|Prov. 20:22}}
Why are some prayers not answered There are four major causes of unanswered prayers
Unbelief. {{jm 1:6,jm 1:7|James 1:6-7}}
An unforgiving spirit. {{mk 11:25|Mk. 11:25}}
Asking against the will of God {{jm 4:3|James 4:3}} or asking amiss or with wrong motives.
CONCLUSION A fruitful and consistent quiet time brings out a balanced spiritual development in at least three different areas:
Healthy and fruitful Bible Knowledge: {{ps 119:9,ps 119:11,ps 119:105|Ps. 119:9, 11, 105}}; {{eph 3:16|Eph. 3: 16}}; II Tim 2: 15; {{ps 19:8|Ps. 19:8}}; {{ho 4:6|Hos. 4:6}}
Fruitful Prayer Life: Pr. 28:9; 15:8,29
An enviable Christian character: {{mt 5:16|Mt. 5:16}}; I Pet. 3:2; {{ph 3:20|Phil. 3:20}}; I Pet. 3:15-16

blocks.text: BIBLICAL FASTING Introduction: Fasting is imperative for Christians. It is essential, among other things, to deal with the flesh, the human nature that prevents us from prospering in the things of the spirit. Apostle Paul said "But I keep my body under and bring it into subjection..." ({{1co 9:27|1 Cor. 9:27}})

What is Fasting? Fasting means abstinence and Biblical fasting means abstaining from food and drinks for a period. Thus fasting is an act of denying our selves of things that give us pleasure with a view to suppressing the flesh and uplifting the spirit. Fasts could be divided as follows: Absolute fast: Abstinence from food and water for a stipulated period of time. After 3 days it is medically advisable to drink water Normal fast: A meal is taken after 12 hours; water may be taken in between depending on the duration of the fast.

A Christian or a Believer; {{2sm 12:16|2 Sam. 12:16}}; 2 Cor.6:5, 11:17. A group of Believers; {{act 13:1,act 13:2,act 13:3|Acts 13:1-3}} A whole nation {{jn 3:5,jn 3:6,jn 3:7,jn 3:8,jn 3:9|Jonah 3:5-9}} {{et 4:15,et 4:16,et 4:17|Esther 4:15-17}}

items: Purpose of a fast: {{is 58:6,is 58:7,is 58:8,is 58:9|Isa. 58:6-9}}
To lose the bands of wickedness, to undo heavy burdens, to let the oppressed go free, to break every yoke, to give bread to the hungry, to restore the poor, to clothe the naked.
To put down our flesh and increase our spiritual capacity, strength and awareness, "but they that wait on the Lord shall renew their strength..." Isa. 40; 31, {{ps 35:13|Psalm 35:13}}
To make the purpose of God in your situation clearer as you become more receptive in the spirit
To gain and possess keener perception of divine issues and clarity of thought,
To help kindle and develop faith; through fasting spiritual fire is kindle and faith operates well.
To help break the power of Satan, and bring about deliverance and healing, {{mk 9:28,mk 9:29|Mark 9:28-29}}
To help improves your prayer life {{lk 11:9,lk 11:10,lk 11:11|Luke 11:9-11}}
To enhance continuous flow of Gods anointing;
We fast so that our sprit will readily be alive to hear when God speaks. {{act 13:3,act 13:4|Acts 13:3-4}}
When do we fast?
When asking for divine secrets. Dan. 93, 20-22; 10:2-3
When about to take a crucial decision; {{et 4:15,et 4:16|Esther 4:15-16}}
When sick and in need of deliverance {{mk 9:29|Mark 9:29}}
When preparing for a great task, revival, etc Mathew 4:1-3
When asking God for intervention; {{ne 1:3,ne 1:4|Nehemiah 1:3-4}}, 2 Chro. 20:3-10
When interceding for others; {{dn 9:3|Daniel 9:3}}
Whenever you need to hear from God; {{act 13:3,act 13:4|Acts 13:3-4}}

blocks.text: 4. How to operate Biblical fasting When fasting, you need to be very close to God, seeking his face in prayers and supplication for the duration of the fast. If the fast goes beyond 3 days it is not medically advisable to continue without drinking water Where the person fasting need to undertake some heavy tasks or undertake long distance journeys, drinking of liquid is advisable The duration of a fast should be a covenant between you and God, with a clear purpose; else, the fast may be as waste of time, a hunger strike or dieting Abstain from sex during fasting as agreed between husband and wife. {{1co 7:5|1 Cor. 7:5}} Be prayerful and continuously meditate on the word of God, listen to hear from the Holy Spirit during the fast. When you are done fasting, ending the fast should be done with caution and discipline, exercise more self control so that your health is not impaired. 5. Medical Benefit of fasting? Discuss

conclusion.text: Apostle Paul declared that he fast often {{2co 11:27|2 Cor. 11:27}}. Every believer should have a regular period of fasting every week, month etc. Pray daily. Jesus, David and Paul fasted and prayed. Do nothing to indicate to people that you are fasting if you desire a reward from it. Mathew 6: 16-18
